title: ROOTSHADOW — Surface vs root-zone recovery-lag trend audit

source.source: NASA POWER daily (MERRA-2 derived, gridded), prefetched by project acquisition workflow
source.integrity_note: Locally recorded SHA-256 checks verify files against acquisition manifests, not field measurements or independent NASA authentication.

method.baseline: Fixed 1991–2020 seasonal percentiles, ±15-day circular window, midranks for ties.
method.drought: Root-zone percentile ≤ 20 for ≥ 30 days (gaps ≤ 5 days bridged).
method.recovery: First sustained (≥ 7 days) return of EACH layer to ≥ 40th percentile — the same threshold for both layers. Delay = root recovery − surface recovery.
method.censoring: Delays cut off by record end or a new drought are reported as lower bounds, never as complete lags.
method.annual_metric: Mismatch days (surface recovered, root zone not) assigned to their actual calendar years; event counts assigned to the year of surface recovery.
method.trend: PRIMARY: Theil–Sen slope + Kendall tau of completed recovery delays vs date. SECONDARY: annual mismatch days with Hamed–Rao autocorrelation-corrected Mann–Kendall and block-bootstrap CI (zero-inflated, low power).
method.null_model: Surrogate root-zone series from a linear transfer fitted on the model's own surface→root behaviour; compares observed lag and slope to that null.
method.limitations: POWER wetness is MERRA-2 model output (gridded, not in-situ). Surface and root zone come from the same land model, so a recovery lag alone is not evidence of an unusual environmental event. Forcing/assimilation changes in the reanalysis can create spurious trends. Not validated against independent data (SMAP, GLDAS, stations, MODIS) in this build.

lag_trend.caveat: Event-level test; serial dependence not corrected, few events, selection by thresholds. Approximate.

trend.method: Hamed–Rao (1998) modified Mann–Kendall for significance; OLS slope with block-bootstrap CI
trend.caveat: Annual event metrics are sparse and zero-inflated, so the Theil–Sen slope is often exactly 0 (median of pairwise slopes) and is reported only for reference; the OLS slope is the headline. p-values are approximate. Significance is not causal attribution.

null_model.assumptions: Linear Gaussian surface→root transfer fitted on the baseline period; residuals resampled i.i.d.; marginal distribution rank-matched to observed. Nonlinear model physics and residual autocorrelation are not captured.

sensitivity.note: The 9-cell grid and the 7/9 agreement rule are PROPOSED robustness checks, not established scientific standards.

audit.explanation: Insufficient data or events: ≥ 8 complete drought–recovery cycles

checks.check: Slope sign agrees in ≥ 7 of 9 threshold settings
Supporting: annual mismatch days, Hamed–Rao p < 0.05

audit.caution: Thresholds in these checks are proposed rules, not established standards. Passing them does not establish causation or a real-world drought impact.

scientific_validation_status: Exploratory single-point MERRA-2 model screening. Not independently corroborated or operational.
